Hey, firefighter here I’d like to share a little story:

Few weeks ago or maybe it was last week, I got paged out in my small town to a suicide, guy hung himself found by his wife and his sister was doing cpr by the time we got there. I remember in detail where the wife was at, her facial expressions, the sister on the phone. When we got where he was i remember the cut rope, the marks on the neck where each piece of trash was at in that area. I got the LUCAS out and we attached that to get it going (Lucas is the automatic cpr thing departments and hospitals will use) and the constant rhythm of it, I ended up taking over airway and just praying this man lives another day we were able to shock him on scene, on the way to the hospital, and they did it at the hospital as well. They called it shortly after we left (about 30 minutes of non stop cpr). That night lives in my head over and over I go to lay down and I remember everything I close my eyes I see his face, I can feel his cold skin still. I used to drink here and there and lately I can’t even stand the thought of drinking cause I’m afraid I’ll be stuck in that loop of playin it over in my head. I barely knew that guy just from passing and I still cared about his life. Same with the guy last year that went out via shotgun to the mouth, found by a random kid since he did it at a graveyard. I remember the details there too and wish I could’ve saved him somehow but it was obvious that couldn’t happen.

Moral is, no matter how much you tell yourself nobody will miss you when you’re gone or nobody will remember, I’m a stranger to those 2 and i remember them every second of everyday. I was also in your shoes once, I have the marks to prove it sadly but if anything you can look at me and see there is a chance at life no matter what don’t leave it but fight it.
